item.description:
Flow 3.3.0

Flow 3.3 adds an expandable connection inspector: a colored file-position map and per-segment progress bars, bytes, speeds, ranges and statuses. Active requests are shown separately from queued or completed segments. Connection rows retain stable positions as Auto retunes.

Traffic already below a configured bandwidth limit no longer incurs unnecessary pacing pauses. Transfer integrity, pause/resume, crash recovery and stable menus are verified.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending. macOS may block opening it. Do not disable system security.

Flow 3.2.0

Flow 3.2 adds automatic parallel request tuning. Large resumable downloads compare measured throughput up to 16 requests, favor fewer requests on speed plateaus, and recheck after two minutes. Saved bytes remain intact while the remaining ranges are repartitioned. Bandwidth-limited downloads skip trials, and retryable failures lower the connection ceiling.

The UI shows the active connection count with Auto; priority menus remain stable during refreshes.

Developer preview: Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are pending. macOS may block opening it. Do not disable system security.

Flow 3.1.1

Flow 3.1.1 fixes priority menus closing or blinking during download speed/progress refreshes. Native menus retain their items and selection while open. Menu-bar actions also remain stable, and speed/progress text uses stable widths.

Developer preview: Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are pending. macOS may block opening it. Do not disable system security.
